Research provenance: Schraw G and Dennison RS, Contemporary Educational Psychology 19(4):460–475 (1994), DOI 10.1006/ceps.1994.1033. Original 52 questions, eight conceptual subcomponents in two broader correlated domains; two experiments support broad 2-factor model, alpha ~.90.
